worlds.allsnapshots.adds_hint: "Snapshots add" is the space only snapshots hold, which deleting all of them would free. Save and mod files shared by hard link with a world stay on disk either way. Size counts every file in the snapshot.
worlds.allsnapshots.empty: No snapshots yet. Take one from a world's Snapshots page.
worlds.allsnapshots.title: Snapshots
worlds.busy.operation: An operation is running on this world: {action}.
worlds.delete.final: Take a final snapshot first, labelled "{label}" (about {size}, never removed automatically). If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
worlds.delete.final_unknown: Take a final snapshot first, labelled "{label}" (size unknown, never removed automatically). If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
worlds.delete.folder: Delete the folder {folder}, with its saves, mods and settings ({size}).
worlds.delete.folder_unknown: Delete the folder {folder}, with its saves, mods and settings (size unknown).
worlds.delete.keeps: Keep its snapshots. They stay listed under Deleted worlds and can be restored.
worlds.delete.name_hint: Type {name}, with the same capital letters.
worlds.delete.name_label: Type the world's name to confirm
worlds.delete.question: Delete the world "{world}"?
worlds.delete.refusal.active: This is the active world. Switch to another world before deleting it.
worlds.delete.refusal.busy: {busy} This world cannot be deleted until it ends.
worlds.delete.refusal.newer: This world is from a newer Foreman, so this version will not delete it.
worlds.delete.refusal.unreadable: Because its world.json cannot be read, Foreman will not delete this world.
worlds.delete.title: Delete {world}
worlds.deleted.caption: Snapshots of the deleted world {world}, newest first
worlds.deleted.empty: No deleted worlds. When you delete a world and keep its snapshots, it is listed here.
worlds.deleted.intro: A deleted world keeps its snapshots. Restoring one makes the world again, exactly as the snapshot recorded it.
worlds.deleted.title: Deleted worlds
worlds.error.active: This is the active world, and the active world cannot be deleted.
worlds.error.bad_game_version: Enter the game version as three numbers from a supported line (1.1, 2.0 or 2.1), such as 2.0.77.
worlds.error.damaged.bad_path: This snapshot's files do not match its snapshot.json, so Foreman will not restore it: bad path "{path}". The world was not changed. Restore a different snapshot.
worlds.error.damaged.changed: This snapshot's files do not match its snapshot.json, so Foreman will not restore it: {path} has changed. The world was not changed. Restore a different snapshot.
worlds.error.damaged.changed_since: This snapshot's files do not match its snapshot.json, so Foreman will not restore it: {path} has changed since the snapshot was taken. The world was not changed. Restore a different snapshot.
worlds.error.damaged.missing: This snapshot's files do not match its snapshot.json, so Foreman will not restore it: {path} is missing. The world was not changed. Restore a different snapshot.
worlds.error.name_empty: Enter a name for the world.
worlds.error.name_taken: Another world already has this name. Choose a different name.
worlds.error.no_folder: Choose a folder from the import folder.
worlds.error.no_saves: This folder holds no save files (.zip) at its top level or in a saves folder, so there is nothing to import.
worlds.error.nospace: Nothing was changed: Not enough free disk space: this needs {need}, including {reserve} kept free for the game, but only {free} is free. Free some space and try again.
worlds.error.operation_running: An operation is running on this world. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
worlds.error.restore_name_taken: Another world now has this world's name. Rename that world, then restore this snapshot.
worlds.error.save_clash: The save {name} is in both the folder and its saves folder, so it is not clear which to import. Remove or rename one of them.
worlds.error.save_exists: This world already has a save with that name. Rename the file and upload it again.
worlds.error.save_name: A save's name must end in .zip, must not start with a dot, and must not contain a slash.
worlds.error.save_not_found: This world has no save with that name.
worlds.error.space_age_old: Space Age needs Factorio 2.0 or later. Untick Space Age for a Factorio 1.1 world.
worlds.error.unreadable: This world's world.json cannot be read, so Foreman will not delete it.
worlds.error.unsupported_file: This world holds a file Foreman cannot snapshot: {path} is a symlink or special file, which a snapshot cannot keep. Remove it or replace it with a copy, then try again.
worlds.error.world_changed: This world was changed or deleted while your upload was running. Nothing was saved; upload it again.
worlds.error.wrong_name: The name typed does not match the world's name.
worlds.import.download.hint: The world cannot start until its game image ({image} at its version) is on this host. The download starts after the import, from Docker Hub.
worlds.import.download.label: Also download the game image if this host does not have it
worlds.import.folder.already_text: These folders' newest saves are already in a world. You can import them again.
worlds.import.folder.empty: The import folder is empty. Add a folder of saves to it, then reload this page.
worlds.import.folder.heading: Import a folder
worlds.import.folder.intro: Put a folder of saves in {dir}. Foreman copies the save files ({zip}) at its top level or in its {saves} folder, its {mods} folder if it has one, and the settings files in its {config} folder (not {rconpw}; Foreman makes its own).
worlds.import.folder.many_hint: Tick one folder to choose its name and version below. With several ticked, each becomes a world named after its folder, with its save's version and Space Age setting.
worlds.import.folder.nothing: There is nothing to import: no folder here can be imported, for the reasons given below. Put the save files ({zip}) in a folder, then reload this page.
worlds.import.intro: Importing copies files into a new world. The original files are never moved or changed.

worlds.import.name.hint.one: Shown in Foreman. Up to {count} character.
worlds.import.name.hint.other: Shown in Foreman. Up to {count} characters.

worlds.import.name.label: World name
worlds.import.result.downloads: Downloading the game image for Factorio {versions}. Each world's page shows how the download goes.
worlds.import.skip.gone: It is no longer in the import folder.
worlds.import.skip.no_version: Foreman could not read its save, so its game version is unknown. Import it on its own and enter the version.
worlds.import.space_age.hint: Space Age only applies to Factorio 2.0 and later.
worlds.import.space_age.label: Space Age is on
worlds.import.space_age_off_warning: The save was made with Space Age. Without it, Factorio may not load the save, or may remove its Space Age content.
worlds.import.space_age_on_warning: The save was made without Space Age. Factorio converts it to Space Age when it first starts, and that cannot be undone.
worlds.import.title: Import a world
worlds.import.unimportable.clash: the save {name} is in both the folder and its saves folder, so it is not clear which to import. Remove or rename one of them
worlds.import.unimportable.heading: Cannot be imported
worlds.import.unimportable.no_save: no save at its top level or in a saves folder, so it cannot be imported
worlds.import.upload.intro: Make a new world from one save file. Its mods are not added.
worlds.import.version.ask: Type the version this save was made with.
worlds.import.version.hint: Three numbers, such as 2.0.72. If you type one, it is used instead of the choice above.
worlds.import.version_unknown: Factorio {version} is not a downloaded game image and is not on Docker Hub's list of versions. Check the number.
worlds.list.deleted_gone: Deleted {name}. It had no snapshots, so it cannot be restored.
worlds.list.deleted_kept: Deleted {name}. Its snapshots are under Deleted worlds.

worlds.saves.heading: Saves

worlds.saves.title: Saves of {world}

worlds.snapshots.adds_hint: "Snapshots add" is the space only snapshots hold, which deleting all of them would free. Save and mod files shared by hard link with the world stay on disk either way.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.delete_failed: Foreman could not delete it. The log says why.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.folders: Delete each snapshot's folder under {folder}. You cannot undo this.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.frees: Free {size} of disk space. A file that any other snapshot or a world also holds stays on disk and frees nothing.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.gone_named: {world}: the snapshot {name} is deleted already, so nothing is left to do.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.gone_timed: {world}: the snapshot taken {when} is deleted already, so nothing is left to do.
worlds.snapshots.bulk.leaves: Leave the worlds and every snapshot you did not tick as they are.

worlds.snapshots.bulk.nothing_deleted_un: Nothing was deleted: nothing is ticked.

worlds.snapshots.bulk.some_stayed.one: {failed} of {count} snapshot was not deleted. Each one below says why.

worlds.snapshots.caption: Snapshots of {world}, newest first

worlds.snapshots.delete.folder: Delete the folder {folder}. You cannot undo this.
worlds.snapshots.delete.frees: Free {size} of disk space. Save and mod files this snapshot shares with the world or with other snapshots stay where they are, so they free nothing.
worlds.snapshots.delete.leaves: Leave the world itself and its other snapshots as they are.

worlds.snapshots.delete.title: Delete a snapshot of {world}
worlds.snapshots.done.restored: The world is restored from the snapshot "{label}".

worlds.snapshots.empty: No snapshots yet. Take one above before you try something risky.
worlds.snapshots.label.control: Remove control characters from the label

worlds.world.checking_release: Checking for a newer Factorio release.
worlds.world.delete.heading: Delete
worlds.world.delete.text: Deleting removes the world's folder. Its snapshots stay, so it can be restored.
worlds.world.download_failed: The game image for Factorio {version} could not be downloaded. The details are in Foreman's log. A switch to this world tries the download again.
worlds.world.download_running: Downloading the game image for Factorio {version} from Docker Hub. Reload this page to see when it ends.
worlds.world.rename.heading: Rename
worlds.world.rename.label: Name
worlds.world.rename.text: The new name is shown everywhere in Foreman. The world's folder keeps its name.

worlds.world.runs_unknown: This world runs Factorio of an unknown version.

worlds.world.unchecked: Foreman could not reach Docker Hub to check that Factorio {version} exists. If it does not, the world will not start.
worlds.error.busy: Another operation is running on this world. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
worlds.error.newer_format: A newer version of Foreman wrote this world, so this version cannot change it.
